answer: The dawn tide opens 44 pearl beds for 20 minutes. Each claim locks 90 POA, +30 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,250 POA. A diver must surface a pearl seeded by the last block and the key, live in that window, earning a sable seal from two strangers, each sealing at most two beds. One operator dives two beds at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten dives, twenty seals at once. A missed tide burns 20 POA; a pearl shown twice burns both. Dive times are checked against funding roots: two pearls from one hand count as one. A farm can pay bonds, not five hands at one tide.
